scene:
Three unlabelled areas read left to right, separated by generous space; do not number, title or name the areas.

LEFT AREA, a remark is not an instruction: an adviser figure holding a coffee cup, with an empty speech bubble containing only a small cloud icon, labelled ADVICE ONLY. A dashed navy arrow runs from the bubble to a notepad with a small calculator on it, labelled OPTION TO COST. There is no arrow from the adviser to anything else.

MIDDLE AREA, who decides: a vertical decision record card with four rows, top to bottom, each row a small icon plus a label: a raised hand labelled RECOMMEND; a gavel labelled DECIDE; a stack of plain coins labelled FUND; a toolbox labelled DELIVER. To the right of the DECIDE row, two stacked approval stamps: a smaller stamp showing one person at a desk, labelled CEO: UP TO €500K, and above it a larger stamp showing a board table with several chairs, labelled BOARD: RESERVE & NEW HIRES.

RIGHT AREA, a conditional date: a horizontal timeline starting from a calendar page marked with a meeting table, labelled MAY: BOARD DECIDES HIRES. From it the line forks into two branches: the upper teal branch passes two small new-hire figures and ends at a flag, labelled OCTOBER WITH HIRES; the lower navy branch continues with the current small team and ends at a flag further to the right, labelled JANUARY WITHOUT. The lower branch is drawn solid as the safe default; the upper branch is drawn dashed as conditional.

All coins are plain discs with no symbols; draw no dollar, euro or other currency signs on any object. Calendars, cards, stamps, notepads and people carry no words, letters or numerals of their own. No chapter title, heading or book name anywhere.

TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: ADVICE ONLY, OPTION TO COST, RECOMMEND, DECIDE, FUND, DELIVER, CEO: UP TO €500K, BOARD: RESERVE & NEW HIRES, MAY: BOARD DECIDES HIRES, OCTOBER WITH HIRES, JANUARY WITHOUT. Any other text is a defect.
alt: An adviser's coffee remark is marked advice only and becomes an option to cost; a decision record lists recommend, decide, fund and deliver, with the chief executive approving up to €500,000 and the board keeping reserve draws and new hires; a timeline forks at the May board decision on hires into October with the hires or January without them.
caption: Treat advice as an option, write down who recommends, decides, funds and delivers, and make any date that depends on a pending approval conditional.
